title: Hosted API slice-based slowpath detection and safe rollforward
creator: Miguel Torres
description: Summary: During an escalation from a major customer (Acct: AcmeAnalytics) we observed recurring 5xx/timeouts correlated with a small subset of requests (~2% of traffic) that exercise long-context transformers. The pattern: requests enter a slowpath after KV cache misses, causing downstream queueing and triggering retries that amplify the surge. This ticket tracks detection, a targeted fix that avoids a full-service rollback, and safety controls for staged rollforward.
steps: 1) Instrument slice-based slowpath detector in edge proxy to tag requests hitting long-tail KV miss sequences
2) Add per-tenant soft circuit (graceful degrade to compact model variant) behind feature flag
3) Deploy kvcache admission control to limit concurrent slowpath entries per worker
4) Run staged rollforward: Canary -> 20% -> 100% with telemetry gates
5) Validate rollback path: feature-flag off + instant routing to baseline model
